mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tui_comment (dynamic_id, user_id, content, parent_id, reply_user_id, like_count, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{dynamicId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{parentId}, #{replyUserId}, #{likeCount}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, dynamic_id, user_id, content, parent_id, reply_user_id, like_count, status, create_time, update_time FROM tui_comment WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE tui_comment SET like_count = like_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE tui_comment SET like_count = like_count - 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0 AND like_count > 0
UPDATE tui_comment SET status = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tui_comment WHERE dynamic_id = #{dynamicId} AND status = 0
